Map

The whole city,
every offer in its place

The map opens on your city’s offers, each card standing where the shop is.

  • Every offer at its branchA card on the map tells you what the offer is and where, before you tap it.
  • Nearby shops, groupedShops close together show as one circle with their count; tap it to zoom in and split them.
  • A branch’s offers in one tapTap a card to see everything the branch is offering, with a Directions button to Google Maps.
  • We never ask where you areThe map shows where the shops are. It does not need to know where you are.
